title: PIZZA INVADERS
oneLiner: Blast the falling pizza aliens before they cover the sky!
mechanics: Slide the pizza fighter left and right along the bottom.
Press A to fire zesty shots upward at invading pizzas.
Destroy rows of pizzas for points before they descend too far.
Alien waves speed up and their shots become more frequent over time.
lose: You lose when a pizza alien reaches the ground or your fighter is hit too many times.
scoring: Earn points for every pizza alien destroyed, with bonus points for clearing a wave.
